description: Implementation of CategoryDao interface for accessing Category entities in the database, including numerous querying methods based on different criteria such as name, URL, code, and hierarchical relationships.

classes.name: CategoryDaoImpl
classes.description: Data Access Object implementation for Category entity, providing various methods to retrieve categories based on different filters such as name, URL, code, hierarchy, and store.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of categories matching the given name within a specific merchant store and language.

methods.name: listBySeUrl
methods.description: Fetches categories based on their SEO URL for a given store.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a single category matching the provided SEO URL within a specific store.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a category by its code within a specific store.

methods.name: getByCodes
methods.description: Returns categories that match a list of codes within a store and language context.

methods.name: getByIds
methods.description: Retrieves categories based on a list of category IDs for a store and language.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Fetches a category by ID with associated description in a specific language.

methods.name: getByCode (overloaded)
methods.description: Retrieves a category by code and store code.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a category by its ID.

methods.name: listByLineage
methods.description: Lists categories based on their lineage pattern within a store.

methods.name: listByDepth
methods.description: Lists categories at a specific depth within a store, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: listByParent
methods.description: Lists child categories of a specific parent category, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: listByStoreAndParent
methods.description: Lists categories for a store with a specific parent category, or top-level if null.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all categories within a store.

methods.name: countProductsByCategories
methods.description: Counts products associated with categories within a store, grouped by category.

methods.name: listByStore (overloaded)
methods.description: Lists categories within a store filtered by language.
